name: find_released_order
title: Find released order
description: Find purchase orders already released to a supplier, by supplier name and/or item code. Returns each order's number, item, quantity, need-by date, value and status. Use it before amending, so you amend the right order.

supplier.description: part of the supplier's name, e.g. Deccan

orders.description: po_no, supplier, item_code, quantity, need_by, gross_value, status

next_step.description: what to do next, when there is something to ask
